# Ready-to-copy prompts for course part 2 (M8–M14)

Build in this order. For each milestone: start a new Claude Code session on this repository,
choose the model named in the heading, paste the block, and wait until it says the pull request
is ready. Then the review session, then (only if the review lists items) the fix session, then
merge (`docs/SETUP.md` §4).

## M8: Schema version 2 and the 12 sharp/flat cards

### 1. Build (Sonnet 5.5)
```
Read CLAUDE.md, docs/HANDOFF.md, docs/build/README.md and docs/build/STANDARDS.md. Then execute docs/build/M8.md step by step, exactly as written, using docs/build/SPEC.md (especially section 8), docs/build/CURRICULUM.md (Part 2) and docs/build/SCHEMA-V2.md as the reference. Do not make product or design decisions that the documents don't cover: stop and ask me. Never wipe, reset or overwrite saved progress, and never edit an existing upgrade step or test fixture. Follow the debugging protocol and the "debug again" pass. Run npm run verify before every push. When done, open a pull request to main (do not push to main) with the definition-of-done checklist, and tell me in plain words what I can now try and anything that isn't verified.
```

### 2. Review (Opus 5.5)
```
Read CLAUDE.md, docs/HANDOFF.md and everything in docs/build/. Review the open pull request for milestone M8 against M8.md, SPEC.md (section 8), CURRICULUM.md (Part 2), SCHEMA-V2.md and STANDARDS.md. Run /code-review high on it. Also run /security-review (this milestone changes how saved progress is read). Follow the "Review step" in M8.md. Check that every step was done as written and every test listed exists and is meaningful. Fix small issues yourself (with npm run verify green before pushing); write anything larger as a numbered list in the PR for a Sonnet fix session. Tell me plainly whether it's ready to merge.
```

### 3. Fix, only if the review listed items (Sonnet 5.5)
```
Read CLAUDE.md, docs/HANDOFF.md and docs/build/STANDARDS.md. Fix the numbered review items on the open pull request for milestone M8, one commit per item, following the debugging protocol. Run npm run verify before pushing, reply on the PR with what changed, and tell me when it's ready.
```
